zoneNote: All times in your calendar's time zone ({zone}). Your device is set to {device}.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.weekStrip: Choose a day of the week
calendar.noWindowsTitle: Your free times, requests and appointments will appear here.
calendar.noWindowsText: Add your working hours first. Without them, members cannot send booking requests.
calendar.panelMissing: This booking request no longer exists or does not belong to your calendar.

block.dialogDescription: Blocked times cannot be requested. Only you see the note.
block.kindBlockerHint: A few hours, for example a private appointment.

errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.failed: Saving did not work. Your entries are still here; try again.

block.removeText: The time becomes free again and members can request it. The private note is lost.
block.removeFailed: The entry could not be removed. Try again.

request.title: Booking request from {name}
request.proposedByMe: Your proposal. The member can accept it or suggest another.
request.noActions: There is nothing left to do for this booking request.
request.reasonHint: The member sees the reason in the history.

confirm.declineText: The request is closed and the member is notified. This cannot be undone.
confirm.cancelText: The appointment is dropped, the time becomes free and the member is notified. This cannot be undone.
confirm.cancelSafetyText: The appointment is dropped; the member only sees “Cancelled”. Afterwards you can report the member. This cannot be undone.
confirm.disputeText: The appointment is recorded as disputed. Briefly describe what went wrong. This cannot be undone.

counterForm.title: Counter-proposal
counterForm.hint: You can suggest any future time, even outside your working hours.
counterForm.past: Choose a time in the future.

errors.conflict: This time overlaps a confirmed appointment or its buffer. With exclusive booking this is not possible. Suggest another time or cancel the other appointment.
errors.stale: The booking request has changed in the meantime. The new state is shown; check it and decide again.
errors.notAllowed: This is no longer possible in the current status. The new state is shown.
errors.invalid: The details are not valid. Check the day, time and duration.
errors.rateLimited: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed; try again.

request.safetyText: If something threatened or unsettled you, report the member. Moderation receives a copy of the latest messages.
request.noteHint: Only visible to you, never to the member.
request.noteFailed: The note could not be saved. The text is still here.

requests.title: Booking requests
requests.intro: Requests to your profile, by status. Open requests expire after the period you set in your availability.

empty.offen: New booking requests will appear here as soon as a member sends one.
empty.abstimmung: Requests with a counter-proposal will appear here.
empty.bestaetigt: Upcoming confirmed appointments will appear here.
empty.vergangen: Completed, cancelled and expired requests will appear here.

availability.title: Availability
availability.intro: When members can request appointments. All times apply in your calendar's time zone.
availability.windowsHint: Recurring time slots per weekday. An end at 23:59 counts until midnight.
availability.windowsInvalid: Not saved yet. Correct the marked time slots.

editor.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start. Choose a later time.
editor.overlap: This time slot overlaps another on the same day. Adjust the start.
editor.incomplete: Enter a time or remove the time slot.
editor.invalidTime: Enter the time as HH:MM, for example 14:30.

availability.timeZoneHint: Appointments are stored and shown in this zone.
availability.bufferHint: Before and after a confirmed appointment you cannot be requested for this long.
availability.ttlHint: Without a reply a request expires after this, at the latest at the proposed start.
availability.noticeHint: A request must arrive at least this long before the start.
availability.saveFailed: Saving did not work. Your entries are still here; try again.
availability.exclusive: Only one appointment at a time
availability.exclusiveHint: When on, you cannot accept a request that overlaps a confirmed appointment including its buffer. When off, confirmed appointments may overlap.
availability.blocksEmpty: Holidays, absences and blocked times will appear here.

state.slow: This is taking longer than usual.
state.errorTitle: This page could not be loaded.
state.errorDescription: Your entries are safely stored. Reload the page; if it still fails, try again later.

fields.invalidDate: Enter the date as DD.MM.YYYY, for example 24.11.2026.
fields.invalidTime: Enter the time as HH:MM, for example 18:00.
